messages.author: 0a74462c0deb4cc5
messages.subject: embedded nul(s) found in input
parts:
Hi, I'm new to this but have a hopefully easy question!

I'm reading in a file (list) from an hadoop cluster in to R Studio.

myfile <- from.dfs(hdfs.data,make,input.format(format="csv",sep=",")

This works perfectly for a test file (all positions in list are complete) but fails on data where there are nulls / empty positions.

the message reads;

Warning message:
In scan(file=file, what=what, sep=sep,quote=quote,dec=dec, :
embedded nul(s) found in input

now it wouldn't be a problem if it was just a warning but it drops observations - just over 20% of records.

any ideas on how I can solve this?  either an option or a different method?

messages.author: 63023c771a070260
messages.subject: Re: embedded nul(s) found in input
parts:
Read help(read.table). If there a way to skip faulty rows, which on top of my mind there should be, make a note of the necessary arguments. Then create an input format as you did with make.input.format("csv, sep  ",", ...) and add the additional options in place of the dots. rmr2 is just using read.table on chunks of input, so if read.table does it, rmr2 should as well (with the exception of headers, which don't work with partitioned files as of the current version). Please mark this answer as complete or "best answer" if this suggestion solves your problem.


Antonio
